video_title: Is there a case that Jayson Tatum should of been traded instead 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: debating if the Celtics made a financial decision regarding their roster
quotes.excerpt: You're basically holding the team hostage with those two guys and they haven't won.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Brad says it is difficult to build a team with 70% of the cap in two players. Are you calling bullshit?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Bullshit. That is bullshit. I get the money aspect of it. 70% of the cap is tied up to two guys. I think the league is going away from that. You're basically holding the team hostage with those two guys and they haven't won. They got a first-round exit. They basically said you're replaceable.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Do you think it was a money thing or do you think it was a player thing?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I think it is a little bit of both. I think like he said, part of it is a lot of the money is tied up into two guys, so it is hard to go sign other pieces to help you win, help you be successful. We have all talked about that.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: discussing the impact of trade rumors on the Celtics locker room
quotes.excerpt: When you start getting things like that happening, words being said, media starting these narratives, it can mess up a locker room.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I think Jaylen Brown subliminally did some stuff and put a narrative out there and that sometimes can mess up a locker room. I think if you look at the Boston Celtics over the last few years, they have been a team that has been together, liked each other. I don't know how they feel when they step off the court. But when you start getting things like that happening, words being said, media starting these narratives, it can mess up a locker room. You definitely don't want a locker room tension full of two of your best players.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: So you got to pick one. We all know they was going to pick Jayson Tatum. Jayson Tatum being the franchise guy since forever. So we know they was going to pick him, so you know Jaylen Brown is the odd man out. Great player. I would love to have him on my team.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: evaluating the tradeability of Jaylen Brown versus Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: Who is more marketable? So I am just saying that is how it goes, unfortunately.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Draymond Green is more vocal, he is more outspoken, he has a podcast, he is going to speak his mind. Stephen Curry, stay behind the scenes, going to be quiet, going to play, going to do his thing. Who is going to be the person you are going to keep? Both of them is very important. I am just speaking of Jaylen Brown because Jaylen Brown does a lot of talking. You got one guy who is quiet, behind the scenes, he does commercials, he has his kids, kids all in the commercials, he who is more marketable?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Now you right. Regardless of the year that Jaylen Brown had, he could have had an MVP year, he still was going to go. Because they knew they couldn't keep the team together for so long. They made that decision a while ago. It didn't matter what kind of year Jaylen Brown had. Jaylen Brown, you are the tradeable guy that we are going to get rid of. Jayson Tatum is our future. Jayson Tatum is our guy that we are building around.
